subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 grouped executable-action upgrades after exact-head checks pass, including the GitHub App token, Docker credential, CodeQL, and Codex-agent changes?
rationale: The patch has no demonstrated correctness defect, but it changes upstream code that runs with credentials or security-scanning authority, and the protected security ownership decision cannot be inferred from ordinary CI alone.

options.title: Approve the grouped upgrade
options.body: Security owners review the upstream deltas and approve merging the full-SHA update once required checks pass or failures are documented as unrelated.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker-login, and CodeQL updates into narrower PRs if independent review or rollback is required.

options.title: Hold the update
options.body: Keep the current pins until an upstream contract concern or current-head validation failure is resolved.

recommendation.title: Approve the grouped upgrade
recommendation.body: Security owners review the upstream deltas and approve merging the full-SHA update once required checks pass or failures are documented as unrelated.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the affected CodeQL and dependency-guard workflow boundaries to this security-operations team.
